# Rohan Ekam Balewadi, Pune

> Rohan Ekam is a landmark 13-acre luxury riverfront residential development situated along the Mula River behind Balewadi High Street in Balewadi, Pune (PIN 411045). Conceptualized by Rohan Builders (India) Pvt. Ltd. (CRISIL DA2+ rated) and master architect Ar. Sanjay Mohe (Mindspace Architects), the project introduces India's first Ground Floor in the Sky at Level 14 across 9 boutique high-rise towers. MahaRERA Phase 1: P52100052298, Phase 2: PR1261012502532. Channel Partner: Propsmart Realty (MahaRERA: A031262401295).
